Access.name: isFondoCollocabile
Access.Query:
select case when (trunc(nvl(dat_fine_sscr_iniz, sysdate)) - trunc(sysdate)) < 0 then -1 else 1 end, case when (trunc(nvl(dat_fine_aggiu, sysdate)) - trunc(sysdate)) < 0 then -1 else 1 end, case when (trunc(nvl(dat_fine_sscr_aggiu, sysdate)) - trunc(sysdate)) < 0 then -1 else 1 end, case when (trunc(nvl(dat_fine_riscat, sysdate)) - trunc(sysdate)) < 0 then -1 else 1 end
from cat_prod.DETT_OPERT_PROD where cod_prod_contnre = ? AND cod_tipo_sist_orig_disp = ? and gstd_f_esist='S' and dat_iniz_colloc_bmed <= trunc(sysdate) and nvl(dat_fine_colloc_bmed, to_date('99991231', 'YYYYMMDD')) >= trunc(sysdate)
